Databicks is updating their dashboard capability on a **monthly** basis, do not be perturbed if things do not look exactly the same.

## ADA guidance

Currently the ADA team do not manage their own guidance but do point you to one of three sources:

-[Microsoft's guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/azure/databricks/dashboards/tutorials/)
-[Databrick's guidance on creating a dashboard](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/dashboards/tutorials/create-dashboard)
-[Databrick's guidance on AI/BI dashboards](https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/dashboards/manage/visualizations/custom-visualizations)

## Creating a Dashboard in Databricks

You can find the option to create a new dashboard in the side bar under the SQL area.

![Location of Dashboards in Databricks](/images/ada-databricks-dashboards-location.png)

Upon navigating to the Dashboard page, you can find you previously created dashboards and the option to create a dashboard in the top right corner.

![Location of Create Dashboard](/images/ada-databricks-dashboards-create-dashboard.png)

## Dashboard first page

When you click "Create Dashboard", you are navigated to the opening page for creating a dashboard where you can either use Genie, or manually create a dashboard.

![Opening Dashboard page](/images/ada-databricks-dashboards-opening-page.png)

## Using Genie

As with other areas of databricks, Genie can create new dashboards for you and find data within your data catalog with which to create them. 

![Using Genie](/images/ada-databricks-dashboards-using-genie.png)

It covers a lot quickly but needs guidance to narrow down on the purpose of the dashboard.

![Genie Output](/images/ada-databricks-dashboards-using-genie-output.png)

## Manually adding data

You can manually add data by clicking on the data tab in the opening page.

![Manually adding data](/images/ada-databricks-dashboards-manually-adding-data-1.png)

Then you can either select to manually add data using Unity Catalog that has a normal folder structure.

![Manually adding data by Unity Catalog](/images/ada-databricks-dashboards-manually-adding-data-unity-catalog.png)

You can also use standard SQL to import data.

![Manually adding data by SQL](/images/ada-databricks-dashboards-manually-adding-data-sql.png)

## Manually adding a visualisation

You can add a visualisation using the bottom bar.

![Adding a visualisation](/images/ada-databricks-dashboards-adding-visualisation.png)

Then just as with PowerBI you can change the chart type and set options.

![Options for a visualisation](/images/ada-databricks-dashboards-powerbi-options.png)
